status: Approved assets integrated into SmartCard presentation
style: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone production SmartCard illustration for Mad Buddy, transparent background with actual alpha. Warm hand-drawn flat editorial illustration: expressive clean shapes, restrained subtle grain, charcoal outlines, burnt orange, muted sage, warm cream used ONLY within objects, rich brown skin for human scenes. Youthful Ghanaian/African everyday social character. No glossy 3D, photorealism, emoji look, logos, lettering, numbers, captions, surrounding card, rectangular backdrop, white box, or full scene background. A compact attractive freestanding vignette centered on a 4:3 canvas, generous transparent perimeter. Keep objects chunky and legible at small size. People must have clean anatomy, simple believable hands, no fused fingers or limbs. General groups are atmosphere, never individual portraits or avatar circles.
